root_cause.mechanism: When a generator function is passed as a `field_transformer`, it returns a generator iterator. Previously, `attrs = field_transformer(cls, attrs)` assigned the generator directly to `attrs`. When `attrs` was iterated multiple times (or first consumed when checking attribute orders / converting to `AttrsClass` / collecting base attributes by subclasses), the generator iterator was exhausted, resulting in empty attributes and unexpected initialization errors. Wrapping the result of `field_transformer` in `list(...)` ensures that generator-based field transformers can be iterated safely multiple times.
